cli.aida_help.aida: Aida's profile notes: record what she should remember
cli.aida_help.note: Append a note under 'About the operator' in system_prompt.md
cli.aida_help.note_text: The note to record; omit to read it from STDIN
cli.aida_help.note_description: Record a note into <config root>/system_prompt.md, inside the marked 'About the operator' section, so every future session and subagent sees it. The file is resolved from the config root and is never an argument; the note must not contain the section markers. Omit TEXT to read the note from STDIN (multi-line notes need no quoting).
